source_excerpt: Malaria is a serious disease caused by a parasite. You get it when an infected mosquito bites you. source_excerpt: Salmonella is the name of a group of bacteria. In the United States, it is a common cause of foodborne illness . source_excerpt: Measles is an infectious disease caused by a virus. It spreads easily from person to person. It causes a blotchy red rash. The rash often starts on the head and moves down the body. source_excerpt: Chickenpox is an infection caused by the varicella-zoster virus. Most cases are in children under age 15, but older children and adults can get it. source_excerpt: COVID-19 (coronavirus disease 2019) is an illness caused by a virus. This virus is a coronavirus called SARS-CoV-2. source_excerpt: Chikungunya is a virus that spread by the same kinds of mosquitoes that spread dengue and Zika virus . source_excerpt: Listeriosis is a foodborne illness caused by Listeria monocytogenes, bacteria found in soil and water. source_excerpt: Diphtheria is a serious bacterial infection. You can catch it from a person who has the infection and coughs or sneezes. source_excerpt: What is the flu? The flu, also called influenza, is a respiratory infection caused by viruses. Each year, millions of Americans get sick with the flu. source_excerpt: What is pneumonia? Pneumonia is an infection in one or both of the lungs. It causes the air sacs of the lungs to fill up with fluid or pus. source_excerpt: What is COPD? COPD (chronic obstructive pulmonary disease) is a group of lung diseases that make it hard to breathe and get worse over time. description: Gangguan dan peradangan pada tulang tumit serta jaringan ikat penyangga telapak kaki (termasuk fasciitis plantaris dan tendinitis Achilles) akibat tekanan berlebih saat berjalan, berlari, atau alas kaki yang tidak menopang.

source_excerpt: Tendons are flexible bands of tissue that connect muscles to bones. They help your muscles move your bones. Tendinitis is the severe swelling of a tendon. source_excerpt: Eczema is a term for several different types of skin swelling. Eczema is also called dermatitis.
